Welcome to the IEM Local Storm Report (LSR) App! The
            old version of this app is still available for
            use, but this new version is the way forward. It is built using
            modern web technologies and is designed to be mobile friendly.

Please provide feedback on
            this app. It is a work in progress and your input is valuable.

This app displays National Weather Service (NWS) Local Storm Reports
                (LSR)s for a given time period of your choice.  Additionally, NWS
                Storm Based Warnings (SBW) are also displayed for events
                Issued between the start and end time of your
                choice.

This app uses to main GeoJSON web services to provide the data
                displayed here. LSR and
                SBW.  You are
                welcome to use these services in your own applications.
